This makes it easy to see which route  an asset represents and where its public activity appears. Choose what to browse Page What it shows Tokens ERC-20 tokens and configured Zipped Asset routesToken Transfers Recent transfers, mints, and burnsUnified Assets  The account-facing assets shared across compatible routesChains Source chains, asset coverage, confirmation rules, and chain details    Read a token page The Tokens directory shows the token name and symbol, source chain, Polyester contract, source-chain contract, type, price, supply, and TVL when that data is available.       A configured Zipped Asset includes a Verified badge and route information. Open it to see: its source chain and source asset; its contract on Polyester Chain; the Unified Asset it maps to; transfers, holders, and related Flows; and public contract information. A generic ERC-20 token can still appear in Scan, but it does not include the configured route or Unified Asset relationship.  A Verified badge identifies a configured asset The badge means Scan recognizes the token from Polyester's asset catalog. It does not apply to every token with the same symbol and is separate from a contract audit. Read token transfers The Token Transfers page shows the transaction, method, block, sender, recipient, amount, and token for each indexed ERC-20 action. Open a transaction to see whether the action was a transfer, mint, or burn and how it fits into the rest of the transaction. If it belongs to a supported cross-chain movement, the related Asset Flow provides the complete journey. Read a chain page The Chains directory lists the external chains configured for Zipper  routes. It includes each chain's ID, native asset, number of configured routes, required confirmations, and estimated confirmation time.       Open a chain to see its: related deposit and withdrawal Flows ; configured Zipped Assets; chain and native-asset identifiers; address format; and external explorer link.       Confirmation time is an estimate based on the configured number of blocks and typical block time. It can change with the source chain. Connect a chain to an asset The source chain and source contract identify what arrives from the external chain. The Polyester contract identifies the matching Zipped Asset on Polyester Chain. The Unified Asset link shows the balance identity that you use inside your Polyester account. Use zAssets & uAssets for a closer look at that relationship. Related Topics  Overview  Explore public Polyester Chain activity, assets, contracts, and cross-chain flows. zAssets & uAssets  See how route-specific Zipped Assets connect to one Unified Asset balance. Asset Flows  Follow deposits, withdrawals, and internal transfers from start to finish in Polyester Scan. Chain Activity  Browse Polyester Chain blocks, transactions, addresses, and public execution details. Contracts & Tools  Explore verified contracts and use Polyester Scan's filters, exports, statistics, gas, and API tools. You can inspect verified source code, read public contract data, filter transactions, export tables, and view Chain statistics. Verified contracts The Verified Contracts directory lets you search by name or address and filter by compiler. Each row can show the contract address, name, compiler version, balance, activity, verification time, and license information. Verification means the submitted source code and compiler settings match the deployed bytecode. Polyester labels can also identify trusted protocol contracts, Zipper  endpoints, smart accounts , and Zipped Assets .  Verification and auditing are different Verified source makes a contract's code easier to inspect. An audit is a separate security review with its own deployment, scope, and report. Use a contract page Depending on the contract, its page can include: Code for source files, compiler settings, ABI, bytecode, and constructor arguments; Read Contract for viewing public contract data without signing a transaction; Write Contract for calling a method through a connected account; and Read Proxy or Write Proxy when the address uses a recognized proxy.             Proxy pages keep the proxy address and history visible while using the current implementation for available methods. A write creates a real Chain transaction and can move assets or change contract state. For normal Polyester activity, use the supported product page unless a protocol guide specifically directs you to call a contract. Filter and export activity The Advanced Filter narrows indexed transaction activity by type, method, date, sender, recipient, amount, and asset. You can also choose which columns appear. Download Page Data is available on many populated tables, including transactions, blocks, flows, accounts, contracts, tokens, Unified Assets , chains, and filtered activity. The download includes the current page and active filters. Chain and data tools Tool What it provides Statistics Charts for accounts, transactions, blocks, tokens, gas, contracts, and user operationsGas Tracker Current Chain utilization and fast, normal, and slow gas estimatesAPI view The read endpoint and JSON response behind supported Scan detail pagesSettings Timezone, number and date formats, address display, density, motion, and theme    Gas Tracker estimates apply to Polyester Chain . They are separate from external-chain deposit or withdrawal fees and from trading fees. The API button on a supported page shows the exact read URL used by the current environment. Use the linked Developer Docs for larger integrations and paginated data access. Public contract data Contract source, methods, logs, state changes, and transaction history are public Chain information. Connecting an account lets you sign supported write actions, but it does not expose your private Polyester Trading balance, orders, permissions, or sessions. Related Topics  Overview  Explore public Polyester Chain activity, assets, contracts, and cross-chain flows. zAssets & uAssets  See how route-specific Zipped Assets connect to one Unified Asset balance. Asset Flows  Follow deposits, withdrawals, and internal transfers from start to finish in Polyester Scan. Chain Activity  Browse Polyester Chain blocks, transactions, addresses, and public execution details. Tokens & Chains  Browse assets, token transfers, and the source chains connected to Polyester. Each entry links to the page where the concept is
covered in depth. For a broader map of how these systems fit together, see Key Concepts.       Term Definition Applies to Term Address Book Entry Definition A saved destination address and its label. Applies to Wallet, Withdrawals, SecurityTerm API key Definition A revocable credential used to access Polyester programmatically. Applies to API, Security, DesktopTerm BALL Definition The native gas asset of Polyester Chain. Polyester sponsors gas for supported product actions. Applies to Polyester Chain, GasTerm Base Asset Definition The first asset in a trading pair and the asset being bought or sold. Applies to Trading, MarketsTerm Deposit Flow Definition The complete journey of an asset moving from an external chain into Polyester. Applies to Funds, Zipper, ScanTerm EOA Definition A blockchain account controlled directly by a private key. Applies to Accounts, SecurityTerm Finality Definition The point when a chain transaction is considered sufficiently permanent. Applies to Deposits, Withdrawals, ChainsTerm Funding Account Definition The account area where deposits arrive and assets remain available for transfers or withdrawals. Applies to Funds, Transfers, DepositsTerm Gas abstraction Definition Polyester's system for sponsoring Polyester Chain gas on supported actions. Applies to Polyester Chain, AccountsTerm GuardSigner Definition A security signer used to approve protected account actions. Applies to Accounts, SecurityTerm Index Price Definition A volume-weighted reference price built from normalized Asset prices across leading centralized and decentralized exchanges. Applies to Trading, Funds, LendingTerm Maker Definition An order that rests on the order book and provides liquidity. Applies to Trading, Fees, APITerm Market Maker Definition A participant or strategy that quotes buy and sell orders to provide liquidity to a market. Applies to —Term Master Account Definition The main Polyester account that owns its Subaccounts. Applies to Accounts, SubaccountsTerm MFA Definition An additional identity check used to protect sensitive account actions. Applies to Accounts, SecurityTerm Owner wallet Definition The external or embedded wallet that authorizes actions for your Polyester Smart account. Applies to Accounts, SecurityTerm PolyEngine Definition Polyester's high-performance system for order admission, matching, and settlement. Applies to Trading, Matching, SettlementTerm Polyester Chain Definition Polyester's EVM-compatible blockchain for accounts, assets, and protocol activity. Applies to Polyester Chain, Accounts, AssetsTerm Polyester Scan Definition The public explorer for Polyester Chain activity, contracts, assets, and Zipper Flows. Applies to Scan, ExplorerTerm Post-only Definition An order setting that prevents the order from immediately executing as a taker. Applies to Trading, Orders, APITerm Quote Asset Definition The second asset in a pair and the asset used to express its price. Applies to Trading, MarketsTerm Route Definition The configured connection between one asset on an external chain and its matching Zipped Asset on Polyester Chain. Applies to Zipper, Funds, DepositsTerm Smart account Definition The Safe account on Polyester Chain that represents a Polyester account. Applies to Accounts, Polyester ChainTerm Subaccount Definition A separate account under a Master Account with its own balances, members, and activity. Applies to Accounts, Trading, APITerm Taker Definition An incoming order that executes against liquidity already on the order book. Applies to Trading, Fees, APITerm Unified Asset Definition The account-facing balance that combines compatible source-chain asset routes. Applies to Funds, Trading, ZipperTerm Unified Trading Account Definition The private balance area used for trading, lending, collateral, and margin. Applies to Trading, Funds, MarginTerm Vault Definition A protected external custody location used by Zipper for a specific asset route. Applies to Zipper, CustodyTerm Withdrawal Flow Definition The complete journey of an asset moving from Polyester to an external chain. Applies to Funds, Zipper, ScanTerm Zipped Asset Definition The Polyester Chain representation of one asset from one source chain. Applies to Funds, Zipper, ScanTerm Zipper Definition Polyester's protocol for bringing supported external assets onto and off Polyester Chain. Applies to Funds, Deposits, Withdrawals     Related Topics  Confirmation Requirements  See the confirmation requirements and estimated deposit times for supported chains. Search FAQs  AllAccountFundsTradingAssets & ChainsFees & RewardsSupportStart Account   Why do I see a different account after signing in?  Each wallet, Google identity, email identity, or embedded owner opens the Polyester account connected to that identity. Sign in with the original owner to return to the expected account. Learn about sign-in and ownership.  Does every Subaccount have its own deposit address?  Yes. Every Master Account and Subaccount receives its own deposit addresses so incoming assets can be credited to the correct account. Learn about Subaccounts.  Can I export an embedded wallet private key?  Yes. You can request an export through the Polyester interface. Polyester does not display the key unless you request it. Learn about account creation.  Can support restore my wallet or private key?  No. Polyester cannot reconstruct a self-custodied wallet, seed phrase, private key, or recovery code. Funds   Where do deposits arrive?  Deposits arrive in your Funding Account unless your Default Deposit Destination sends them directly to Trading. Learn about deposits.  Why is my deposit still pending?  A deposit remains pending while it reaches the required chain confirmations and completes the Zipper validation and crediting stages. Follow the Asset Flow.  Can I withdraw directly from Trading?  Yes. Available assets can be withdrawn from either your Funding Account or Trading Account. Learn about withdrawals.  Are assets in Funding exposed to liquidation?  No. Assets in Funding remain separate from Trading, lending, margin, and the liquidation engine. Learn about Funding.  Does every deposit appear in Funding first?  The route-specific Zipped Asset remains in Funding as on-chain backing. Default Deposit Destination determines whether the matching Unified Asset balance becomes available in Funding or Unified Trading. Learn about deposits.  Can I reuse a deposit address I saved earlier?  Open Deposit for the same account, Asset, and Network before sending. Compare the complete current address and include any memo or destination tag shown. Polyester may return the same address, but you should not assume a saved value is still the active route. Learn about deposits.  Do I need to wrap or zip the Asset first?  No. Send the supported external Asset using the current Deposit instructions. Zipper creates the route-specific Zipped Asset and Polyester credits the matching Unified Asset during the Deposit Flow. Learn about deposits.  Why can the credited amount be lower than the amount sent?  Check the deposit record for any Polyester route fee applied to the gross deposit. The source Network transaction cost is separate and is paid by the sending wallet. Learn about deposits.  How long does a deposit take?  Use the live estimated time and confirmation progress for the selected route. The requirement can change with the Network, transfer amount, and current conditions, and Zipper verification continues after the source transaction confirms. Learn about deposits.  What should I do if the deposit details were wrong?  Do not send another transfer while the first is being investigated. Keep the source transaction ID, selected account, Asset, Network, deposit address, contract, memo or destination tag, and amount. Submit one support request with that evidence. Recovery is not guaranteed. Learn about deposits.  Can I withdraw through a different Network later?  Yes, when Polyester supports an equivalent destination route for the same Unified Asset. The withdrawal still depends on that route's availability, inventory, fee, minimum, policy, permissions, and security checks. Learn about deposits.  Does every deposit appear in Funding first?  Every deposit creates a Zipped Asset that remains in Funding as on-chain backing. Settings > Security lets the active account use Deposit Routing to choose whether the matching Unified Asset balance is first credited to Funding or Unified Trading. Learn about Funding.  Why do deposits from different chains appear as one balance?  Polyester explicitly maps their routes to the same Unified Asset. For example, Ethereum zUSDT and Solana zUSDT can contribute to one USDT Funding balance while their supplies and source-chain backing remain separate. A matching ticker by itself is not enough. Learn about Funding.  Can an open Order use my Funding balance?  No. Orders use the Unified Trading Account. Transfer the amount you want to trade from Funding to Trading first, unless Deposit Routing already credited that Unified Asset balance directly to Trading. Learn about Funding.  Does my Funding balance count as Lending collateral?  No. Assets in Funding do not increase borrowing power, enter the collateral balance, affect Lending health, or become available for liquidation. Transfer an eligible Asset to Unified Trading before using it as collateral. Learn about Funding.  Can I withdraw to a different chain than the one I deposited from?  Yes, when an equivalent destination route is supported and has sufficient inventory. Availability also depends on current policy, minimums, fees, account permissions, and security requirements. Learn about Funding.  Why did Total Equity change when my Balance did not?  Equity uses the Asset's Index Price. When that reference price changes, Equity, Total Equity, Allocation, and Balance History can change while the Asset quantity stays the same. Learn about Funding.  Is the Funding Account the same as my smart wallet?  No. Your smart wallet is the on-chain account controlled by your owner wallet. Funding is the application contract and balance layer that the smart wallet controls for Zipped Assets, Unified Asset balances, and protected Asset movements. Learn about Funding.  Why is Available Balance lower than Total Balance?  Part of the balance is reserved for activity already in progress. Working or partially filled Orders, pending withdrawals or transfers, and an Order's fee budget can reduce Available Balance while leaving Total Balance unchanged. Learn about Trading.  Can I trade directly from my Funding Account?  No. Orders use the Unified Trading Account. Transfer the amount from Funding to Trading first, unless Deposit Routing already credited the Unified Asset balance directly to Trading. Learn about Trading.  Can I move Reserved Balance back to Funding?  No. You can only transfer the amount shown as Available Balance. A reserved amount becomes available again when the Order or pending action releases it. Learn about Trading.  When does an Order reservation return to Available Balance?  Polyester releases the unused amount when the Order reaches a final state. A cancellation can race with a Fill, so check the final Order and its Fills before reusing the balance. Learn about Trading.  Can I withdraw from Trading?  Yes, when the withdrawal flow offers an available route for the Asset. Polyester reserves the amount in Trading, moves it through Funding and Zipper, and applies the route's current fees, minimums, policies, permissions, and security controls. Learn about Trading.  Are Trading balances shared between accounts?  No. Each Master Account and Subaccount has its own Unified Trading Account, balances, Orders, and Fills. Check the active account before trading or transferring Assets. Learn about Trading.  Can I withdraw directly from Unified Trading?  Yes. Choose Unified Trading as the source when the Asset and destination route are available. Only the amount shown as available can leave; balances reserved by orders or pending actions cannot be withdrawn. Learn about withdrawals.  Can I withdraw on a different chain than I deposited from?  Yes. Choose another enabled destination route when it represents the same Unified Asset and the receiving wallet supports that Asset and Network. Learn about withdrawals.  Why is a destination chain unavailable?  Each route needs enough inventory and must pass its current health, minimum, fee, destination, policy, and security checks. Another route for the same Unified Asset may still be available. Learn about withdrawals.  Is a saved Address Book entry automatically approved?  No. Saving an address and approving it for withdrawals are separate. When the active account requires an External Withdrawal Whitelist, the destination must also have an active whitelist record for the selected chain. Learn about withdrawals.  Can I cancel a withdrawal after submitting it?  No. Review the final destination and amount carefully before submitting. Once the external transaction is broadcast, it cannot be canceled or reversed. Learn about withdrawals.  What happens if a withdrawal fails before delivery?  The final withdrawal record shows the outcome. Eligible principal can return when delivery did not become irreversible, although the settled route fee may not be refunded. A withdrawal sourced from Unified Trading returns eligible principal to the same Trading Account. Learn about withdrawals.  Does the recipient need to accept an internal transfer?  No. An active recipient account receives an authorized internal transfer directly. Confirm the receiving account and balance area with the recipient before submitting. Learn about internal transfers.  Can I transfer to a disabled Subaccount?  No. A disabled Subaccount rejects new inbound activity until it is active again. Learn about internal transfers.  What can the recipient see about the sender?  The recipient's Ledger can show the sending Polyester Account ID or Subaccount ID and its public smart-account address. It does not reveal a private username or user-created account label. Learn about internal transfers.  Do I need to wrap or zip before I deposit?  No. Send the supported External Asset with the current Deposit instructions. Zipper creates the Zipped Asset and Polyester credits the Unified Asset during the Deposit Flow. Learn about Unified Assets.  Why do I see one USDT balance after depositing from two Networks?  Polyester mapped those deposit routes to the same Unified Asset. The Zipped Asset supplies and withdrawal routes remain separate even though Funding shows one balance. Learn about Unified Assets.  Can I withdraw on a different Network than I deposited from?  Yes, when Polyester supports an equivalent destination route for the same Unified Asset and the receiving wallet supports that Asset and Network. Learn about Unified Assets.Trading   Why has my limit order not filled?  A limit order remains open until eligible opposite-side liquidity reaches its price or the order is canceled or expires. Learn about limit orders.  What is the difference between maker and taker?  A maker order rests on the order book and adds liquidity. A taker order executes against liquidity already available. See trading fees.  Are my orders and trades public?  No. Your Trading balance, orders, and fills are private and visible only to your account. Learn about trading privacy.  Can Polyester support high-frequency trading?  Yes. PolyEngine is designed for high-throughput, low-latency order processing and supports API-based trading. Learn about PolyEngine.Assets & Chains   Which assets and chains does Polyester support?  The Supported Assets directory lists available assets, chains, fees, minimums, and confirmation requirements. View supported assets.  What is a Zipped Asset?  A Zipped Asset is the Polyester Chain representation of one asset from one specific source chain. Learn about Zipper.  What is a Unified Asset?  A Unified Asset combines compatible source-chain routes into one balance that you can use inside Polyester. Learn about Unified Assets.Fees & Rewards   How are trading fees determined?  Your maker or taker rate is based on your current VIP tier. Eligible referral discounts apply only to positive trading fees. See trading fees.  How is my VIP tier calculated?  Your tier is based on either your rolling 14-day spot volume or your 60-day average account equity, whichever gives you the higher tier. See VIP tiers.Support   Where can I request a feature?  Open Feature Requests to submit an idea or browse requests from the community. Open Feature Requests.  Where can I contact support?  Open My Submissions to create a private support ticket and follow the conversation. Open My Submissions.Start   Which wallets can I use to create an account?  The Create Account screen supports MetaMask, Rabby, and Phantom directly. WalletConnect can connect another compatible desktop or mobile wallet. The selected wallet address becomes the owner credential for the Master Account. Learn about account creation.  Who creates the wallet when I use Google or email?  Turnkey creates and secures the embedded non-custodial owner wallet. Google verifies the selected Google identity, while email verifies access to the selected mailbox. Polyester uses the resulting wallet to create or reopen the Master Account. Learn about account creation.  Where are my private keys stored?  With MetaMask, Rabby, Phantom, or WalletConnect, the private keys remain in the connected wallet. With Google or email, Turnkey stores the encrypted private key and decrypts it only inside secure enclaves for authorized signing. Polyester does not receive the raw private key in either path. Learn about account creation.  Does every account get a smart account?  Yes. Every Master Account and Subaccount receives its own Safe smart account. The Safe identifies the account on Polyester Chain, while the owner credential controls it. Learn about account creation.  Why did signing in show an account with no balances?  A different wallet address, Google identity, or email address can open a different Polyester account. Sign out, return with the identity used during account creation, and confirm the smart account address before taking another action. Learn about account creation.  Can I add another sign-in method to the same Master Account?  Not currently. Another wallet address, Google identity, or email address may open a different Master Account rather than link to the existing one. Learn about account creation.  What happens if I lose access to my sign-in method?  Recovery depends on the owner wallet. Use the wallet's recovery process for an external wallet, or recover the linked Google identity or mailbox for an embedded wallet. If access to an embedded wallet's provider is permanently lost and its private key was not exported beforehand, Polyester cannot replace that owner. MFA and recovery codes do not change Safe ownership. Learn about account creation.  Why do I need MFA if my wallet is already secure?  The owner wallet controls your smart account. MFA separately verifies sensitive actions performed in an interactive Polyester session. One layer does not replace the other. Learn about securing your account.  Should I choose a passkey or an authenticator app?  Choose a method you can keep available on trusted devices. A passkey can use device biometrics or a hardware security key when supported. An authenticator app generates time-based six-digit codes. Enrolling both gives you a backup if one becomes unavailable. Learn about securing your account.  What happens if I lose an MFA method?  Use another enrolled method or one unused recovery code. After restoring access, add a replacement method and regenerate your recovery codes if their storage may have been exposed. Learn about securing your account.  Can Polyester recover my owner wallet or bypass MFA?  Polyester cannot recreate a non-custodial wallet's private keys, bypass the credential that owns your smart account, or replace a permanently lost embedded owner wallet through MFA. Recovery depends on the wallet provider, linked Google identity or mailbox, another enrolled MFA method, or recovery keys that already exist. Learn about securing your account.  Should I export the Turnkey wallet's private key?  Export is not required to use Polyester. An export reveals the private key that controls the embedded owner wallet, so use it only for a deliberate backup or migration. Keep it offline and never send it to support. Learn about securing your account.  Does saving an Address Book entry automatically allow transfers?  No. The Address Book saves destination information for convenience. External withdrawal and internal transfer whitelists separately determine which destinations are permitted when their requirements are active. Learn about securing your account.  Does MFA replace an on-chain whitelist?  No. MFA verifies who approved a protected action. Whitelists enforce where Assets may move. A Withdrawal can require valid MFA and still be restricted to an approved address. Learn about securing your account.  Does every Deposit have to go through Funding first?  No. Deposit Routing can credit a completed Deposit to Funding or Unified Trading by default. The setting belongs to the active Master Account or Subaccount. If the balance is already available in Trading, skip the internal transfer. Learn about first deposit and trade.  Why is my Deposit not available immediately?  The source-chain transaction must meet the route's confirmation requirement before Polyester can credit the balance. Its progress and estimated arrival time appear in the deposit record after the transaction is detected. Learn about first deposit and trade.  Should my first trade use a Market or Limit Order?  Choose based on the result you want. A Market Order prioritizes immediate execution within its configured protections, but it can fill at more than one price. A Limit Order controls the worst execution price, but it may remain partially filled or open. Learn about first deposit and trade.  Does an Order confirmation mean the trade is complete?  It means Polyester accepted the Order. Open Orders, Order History, and Fills show whether it is waiting, partially filled, completed, or cancelled. Learn about first deposit and trade.  Where does the Asset received from a trade appear?  The received Asset appears in the same Unified Trading Account. It can support another eligible Order or be returned to Funding when the balance is available and not reserved. Learn about first deposit and trade. Submit a Support Ticket  Contact Polyester support about a private or account-specific question.
